Keep the existing detail and ask Opus to review any security interpretation or revised security wording.

findings.suggestedChange: I would prefer the three question headings near the start of Evidence, with the current maturity detail below them. Preserve the explicit stage labels.

teachBack: A Web is a proposed set of required proof roles for one financial action; a Strand is an individual proof together with its claim, statement and binding metadata. The page establishes that this is a concept with scoped local records and detailed source readings: it reports local proof and compiled-wrapper experiments, but says the setup is forgeable, source-to-run correspondence is not established, and no on-chain transaction is recorded. It does not establish a production setup, exact compiled-source correspondence, or accepted ledger settlement.
